implicit_expansion: For open roots, recursively append each legal nondecreasing nonzero 20-bit incidence mask until support masks are assigned; enforce total incidences and card sizes 2–10. For geometry85, first require the stated shared-number owner geometry up to slot relabeling. The unvisited suffix and all failed candidates stay open.
domination: A deficient support root reduces to its saturated root for strict-improvement testing. Its layouts need not have identical zero counts.
evidence: Candidate exceptions are retained in candidates.json. A numerical lower bound is accepted only where independently audited.
